## Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read in hg19-kc-count.bed and specify the header

```{r}
  header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
  df_kc <- read_tsv( '/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1/hg19-kc-count.bed', col_names=header )
```

## plot gene density across all 25 main chromosomes

```{r}
p1 <- df_kc %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = count)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ chr, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome position (Mb)",
       y = "Canonical transcripts per 1 Mb") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("exercise1.png", plot = p1, width = 14, height = 20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
